snippet.title: LinkShift - Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3822710/Linkshift/

An addictive new arcade puzzle game that lets you link nodes together to form big chains. Collect these chains to score points. Bend the rules with Master Nodes to create big combos. Enter the zone, take risks, place smartly and master the many different strategies. This is LinkShift.



Tim Overvliet - 2025 - LinkShift - All Rights Reserved
Music by Yevhen Soroka
